titulo_es: Avvisi di circolazione e impreviisti di viaggio

attendere.en: to expect new developments; to expect

frases.it: Il treno regionale 2045 per Genova è fermo a Pavia per un guasto tecnico alla linea.
frases.es: El tren regional 2045 hacia Génova está detenido en Pavía por una avería técnica en la vía.
frases.en: The regional train 2045 towards Genoa is stopped in Pavia by a technical failure on the road.

frases.it: La partenza è prevista con circa quaranta minuti di ritardo rispetto all'orario normale.
frases.es: La salida está prevista con unos cuarenta minutos de retraso respecto al horario ordinario.
frases.en: The departure is expected to be about 40 minutes late compared to the regular schedule.

frases.it: I viaggiatori diretti a Milano possono utilizzare il treno 781 in partenza dal binario tre.
frases.es: Los viajeros con destino a Milán pueden utilizar el tren 781 que sale del andén tres.
frases.en: The 781 train leaving platform three can be used by travellers to Milan.

frases.it: Il biglietto già acquistato resta pienamente valido per la nuova corsa senza costi aggiuntivi.
frases.es: El billete ya adquirido permanece plenamente válido para el nuevo trayecto sin costes adicionales.
frases.en: The ticket already purchased remains fully valid for the new journey without additional costs.

frases.it: Chi prosegue per Genova deve attendere i prossimi aggiornamenti sul tabellone luminoso.
frases.es: Quien continúe hacia Génova debe esperar las próximas actualizaciones en el panel luminoso.
frases.en: Whoever continues to Genoa must wait for the next updates on the bright panel.

frases.it: Il personale della stazione distribuisce bottiglie d'acqua nella sala d'attesa.
frases.es: El personal de la estación reparte botellas de agua en la sala de espera.
frases.en: The station's staff is distributing water bottles in the waiting room.
analisis: the staff of the station is distributed

bloques.titulo: Vocabulary: transport incidents, breakdowns and traveller services

bloques.pregunta: Why is the regional train to Genoa stopped?

opciones.texto: For a technical impact or failure in the infrastructure.
opciones.explicacion: The release specifies: «per un guasto tecnico alla linea».

opciones.texto: Due to adverse weather conditions of snow and wind.
opciones.explicacion: The motive is not weather but a technical failure.

opciones.texto: Por una huelga laboral imprevista del personal de taquilla.
opciones.explicacion: It is not due to labour conflicts.

bloques.pregunta: How long is the estimated delay reported for the convoy's departure?

opciones.texto: About 40 minutes from the regular schedule.
opciones.explicacion: The text indicates: «prevista con circa quaranta minuti di ritardo».

opciones.texto: Fifteen minutes of technical stop on platform.
opciones.explicacion: The official forecast puts the delay at about 40 minutes.

opciones.texto: Two full hours for changing the machine.
opciones.explicacion: The statement doesn't speak for two hours.

bloques.pregunta: What alternative is provided to travellers who are going to Milan?

opciones.texto: Get on the 781 train leaving platform three with the same ticket.
opciones.explicacion: The notice states: «possono utilizzare il treno 781 in partenza dal binario tre; il biglietto resta valido».

opciones.texto: Request the refund of the amount and search for a taxi by road.
opciones.explicacion: The ticket is still valid on the alternative train.

opciones.texto: Hold on platform five until the day tomorrow.
opciones.explicacion: The alternative train is taken on platform 3.

bloques.pregunta: What should passengers whose final destination is Genoa do?

opciones.texto: Wait for new updates to be published in the information panel.
opciones.explicacion: The slogan orders: «deve attendere i prossimi aggiornamenti sul tabellone luminoso».

opciones.texto: Make the immediate transhipment to the train heading to Milan.
opciones.explicacion: The 781 train goes to Milan, not Genoa.

opciones.texto: Get out of the station units without waiting for news.
opciones.explicacion: They must wait for information in the compound.

bloques.pregunta: What attention does the station staff pay to the affected users in the room?

opciones.texto: It delivers water bottles among the passengers in the waiting room.
opciones.explicacion: The text reflects: «Il personale della stazione distribuisce bottiglie d'acqua nella sala d'attesa».

opciones.texto: It offers full hot meals at the outside restaurant.
opciones.explicacion: Only the water supply in the waiting room is mentioned.

opciones.texto: Discount vouchers for purchases in airport shops.
opciones.explicacion: Help the travelers with water while they wait.

bloques.pregunta: What is the validity of the ticket acquired when the trains are reorganized?

opciones.texto: Conserva plena validez para el tren alternativo sin coste suplementario alguno.
opciones.explicacion: The notice confirms: «il biglietto già acquistato resta pienamente valido per la nuova corsa».

opciones.texto: It is automatically cancelled and requires a new ticket.
opciones.explicacion: You don't have to buy another travel degree.

opciones.texto: It is only valid if a recharge of 10 euros is paid in the box office.
opciones.explicacion: It does not require additional costs.

bloques.frase: I viaggiatori possono attendere nella sala d'attesa
bloques.traduccion: Travellers can wait in the waiting room
bloques.explicacion: Prayer of transport service with modal verb and wafer locution.

intro: It interprets railway notices on breakdowns, transshipments, provisional orders and validity of travel documents.
